items.definition: Sailing as close to the wind as the rig permits, with sails tight; the only way to gain ground upwind, done by tacking.

numbers.what: approximate angle to the wind when close-hauled

items.definition: Sailing with wind from the side or from abaft the side, sails eased; gives the fastest and steadiest headings.
Wind coming directly from astern, sails fully out, with a risk of accidental gybe.
Pointing directly into the wind, so sails flap and the boat stalls. Portuguese term not yet confirmed in the source.
Pulling the sail in tighter, for example when heading up toward the wind.
Letting the sail out, for example when bearing away or running.
Reducing sail area as wind increases, or replacing the sail with a small storm sail.
A small storm sail used when the wind rises.
The arrangement of masts and sails; types listed are lateen, gaff with jib, square and lug.
The gaff rig, used together with a jib.
The lug rig, one of the sail arrangements listed.
Steering toward the wind; if overdone, the boat ends up in irons.
Steering away from the wind, to regain speed or turn downwind.
Tacking: turning through the wind to change sides while going upwind, zigzagging between two close-hauled headings.
Gybing: turning with the wind astern so the sail swings across; on a lateen rig the yard passes to the other side of the mast.
Holding the boat across wind and current, as when trawling. Portuguese term not yet confirmed.
Moving with current and wind without steering for speed.
Leeboard: a board lowered to reduce sideways slip in shallow water.
Controlling speed to come alongside another boat or a quay.
Moving the boat without sail: poling in shallows, towing from the bank, or rowing.
Towing the boat from the river bank.
Choosing a heading relative to the wind; the game shows a wind arrow and speed dial as feedback.
Matching the sail setting to the heading; a marker turns green when correct.
The boat's lean, shown as feedback when practising sail reduction as gusts rise.
A sudden increase in wind, tracked by a gust meter, prompting the player to reduce sail.
